name: Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S.
summary: Baskent Dogalgaz Dagitim Gayrimenkul Yatirim Ortakligi A.S. is engaged in providing natural gas distribution services across the Ankara region. This entity, which commenced operations in 2007, has its principal office located in Ankara, Turkey, and functions as a division of Torunlar Enerji Sanayi Ve Tic.A.S.
